thread:
emma: Hi team  Emma here, joining as Product Designer (first day). Two quick blockers: 1) getting 403 on Growth Figma project, 2) where is the single-source roadmap + backlog context, 3) who handles research participant recruiting & consent? TL;DR: perms + docs + research owner?

aisha: welcome Emma! :tada: for Figma, DM me the file link and i'll add you. also ping design-ops if you need palette/component library access.

kevin: i'm design-ops. drop the figma url and your work email here and i'll invite you as Editor (unless you only need Viewer). we maintain the tokens & component library in the "Platform UI" team file.

emma: file: https://www.figma.com/file/GwthUI/rdw-growth-design ; email: emma@redwood.com

kevin: invited you as Editor. if you still see 403, try renewing SSO session:
`open "https://sso.redwood.com" && pkill -f "Google Chrome"`

emma: that fixed it, I can open. thanks! :raised_hands:

aisha: roadmap & strategy live in Notion: https://redwood.notion.site/Product-Roadmap (we keep an "atomic" roadmap and a separate backlog board). For historical context there's a CSV export in the Roadmap > Archive section if you need timelines.

emma: great. who should I ask about prioritization context for Growth experiments? want to understand recent tradeoffs.

robbie: hi Emma  i'm product lead for Growth. ping me and i'll walk you through the last two quarters' decisions. short summary: experiment budget, KPIs (activation, retention), and runway for infra changes.

emma: thanks! last Q: research recruiting & consent — who runs that and how do I request participants / budget?

aisha: Research Guild handles recruiting + consent. start with the Research Playbook in Notion (Research > Playbook) which has screener templates and consent copy. For paid participants open a request in the research form: https://redwood.notion.site/Research-Requests.

kevin: small addition: if you're running prototype tests and need the participant panel, file a "Recruiting" request and tag @research-ops. They usually need 48-72 hrs lead time.
emma: perfect. any quick tips for first-week priorities as designer?

aisha: 1) join Design Crit on Tue 10am PT, 2) read Research Playbook + Product Roadmap top section, 3) clone Growth Figma frames and run a quick audit of component usage. Also watch the New Hire Product intro (20m) in the Onboarding docs.

onboarding-bot: Emma added to: Product Team, Design - Growth, Research Guild. Onboarding checklist updated (Tasks: confirm Figma access, watch intro, request research recruits if needed).

emma: excellent  will join crit and start audits. thanks everyone for the speedy help!"
